description: The file defines the MainViewModel class for an Android application, implementing state management for UI components and integrating with backend runtime logic. It includes numerous state flows, initialization logic, and methods to interact with the runtime, preferences, and UI actions.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: An Android ViewModel managing UI state and interactions for the main app activity, including runtime management, preferences, chat, and device states.

methods.name: attachRuntimeUi
methods.description: Attaches lifecycle and permission handlers to the camera and SMS managers through the runtime.

methods.name: setForeground
methods.description: Sets the foreground state of the runtime, indicating whether the app is active or backgrounded.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Updates the display name preference.

methods.name: setCameraEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the camera via preferences.

methods.name: setLocationMode
methods.description: Sets the device location mode.

methods.name: setLocationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables precise location.

methods.name: setPreventSleep
methods.description: Configures whether to prevent device sleep.

methods.name: setManualEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables manual network configuration.

methods.name: setManualHost
methods.description: Sets manual host address.

methods.name: setManualPort
methods.description: Sets manual port number.

methods.name: setManualTls
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS for manual connection.

methods.name: setGatewayToken
methods.description: Sets the gateway token used for authentication.

methods.name: setGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Sets the bootstrap token for establishing a gateway connection.

methods.name: setGatewayPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for gateway authentication.

methods.name: setOnboardingCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed and ensures runtime initialization.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status for canvas.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingEnabled

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMode
methods.description: Sets the notification forwarding mode.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackagesCsv
methods.description: Sets notification forwarding packages from CSV input.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Configures quiet hours for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Sets maximum notification forwarding events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Sets a session key for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setVoiceScreenActive
methods.description: Sets the voice screen activity state.

methods.name: handleAssistantLaunch
methods.description: Handles launching the assistant with optional auto-send prompt.

methods.name: clearRequestedHomeDestination
methods.description: Clears the current home destination request.

methods.name: clearChatDraft
methods.description: Clears the current chat draft.

methods.name: clearPendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Clears the pending auto-send prompt for assistant.

methods.name: setMicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the microphone.

methods.name: setSpeakerEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the speaker.

methods.name: refreshGatewayConnection

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified gateway endpoint.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a gateway endpoint with authentication details.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Initiates a manual connection.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the current runtime connection.

methods.description: Declines the gateway trust prompt.

methods.name: requestCanvasRehydrate

methods.name: refreshHomeCanvasOverviewIfConnected
methods.description: Refreshes the home canvas overview if connected.

methods.name: loadChat
methods.description: Loads a chat session by key.

methods.name: refreshChatSessions
